### CVE-2002-0386
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2002-10-29 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 21911: Oracle 9i Application Server 9.0.2 Web Cache Administration Tool - Denial of Service (dos/multiple, 2002-10-06, verified=1)

The administration module for Oracle Web Cache in Oracle9iAS (9i Application Suite) 9.0.2 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via (1) an HTTP GET request containing a ".." (dot dot) sequence, or (2) a malformed HTTP GET request with a chunked Transfer-Encoding with missing data.

### CVE-2002-0965
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2003-04-02 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 16341: Oracle 8i - TNS Listener SERVICE_NAME Buffer Overflow (Metasploit) (remote/windows, 2010-11-24, verified=1)

Buffer overflow in TNS Listener for Oracle 9i Database Server on Windows systems, and Oracle 8 on VM, allows local users to execute arbitrary code via a long SERVICE_NAME parameter, which is not properly handled when writing an error message to a log file.
